newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IMF loan important for Russia investment - Chubais.
newsitem.headline: IMF loan important for Russia investment - Chubais.

text.p: Agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) makes Russia more attractive for foreign investors, but the importance of IMF funding is falling, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Wednesday.
"The importance of the credit itself is falling significantly compared a year ago," Chubais, appointed earlier this month, told a news conference.
"The very status of an agreement with the IMF is very important for attracting foreign investment. And Russia is very much interested in foreign investment."
IMF director Michael Camdessus is coming to Moscow on April 1 to meet Chubais and Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and he may meet President Boris Yeltsin.
The IMF is due to decide whether to release overdue tranches of its $10 billion loan to Russia, which have been delayed mainly due to poor tax collection.
